name: After § 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text: 5c. Underlines that effective oversight and accountability mechanisms, including with regard to the use of public funds, are inherent elements of compliance with EU State aid rules and do not, in themselves, constitute political interference, provided that such mechanisms are applied objectively, proportionately and in full respect of editorial and institutional independence;
